'''Kathracite crystal''' was a type of [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]], and a member of the [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystal]] family. For millennia, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] used Adegan crystals, including kathracite, as the [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|focusing crystal]] in their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]].<ref name="TotJC" />
